title: Renewed Hormuz tensions pressure graphite feedstock prices
gist: Renewed Strait of Hormuz tensions tied to the Iran conflict have pushed Brent crude and Chinese slurry prices higher, driving pre-calcined petroleum needle coke — the feedstock for synthetic graphite anodes — up 23% year-to-date on an RMB basis (26% on a USD basis), per Benchmark's Synthetic Graphite Price Assessment.

insights.claim: Renewed tensions around the Strait of Hormuz have reintroduced cost pressure across the synthetic graphite anode value chain by reviving concerns over disruption to Middle Eastern crude oil exports.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A geopolitical chokepoint risk is now a direct transmission channel into battery anode material costs — investors in synthetic graphite/anode names should treat Hormuz headlines as a cost-input signal.

insights.claim: Oil is a key feedstock for petroleum coke, which is in turn used to produce synthetic graphite anodes, creating a direct mechanical link between crude oil prices and battery anode costs.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Establishes the supply-chain mechanism investors can use to forecast anode costs from oil price moves.
insights.locator: "Oil is a key feedstock in the production of petroleum coke..."

insights.claim: Since the start of the Iran conflict, both Brent crude and Chinese slurry prices have risen, with the latest Hormuz escalation pushing Brent prices further higher.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Confirms the oil-to-anode cost chain is already showing up in price data, not just theoretical risk.
insights.locator: "Since the start of the conflict in Iran..."

insights.claim: Prices for pre-calcined petroleum needle coke have risen 23% year-to-date on an RMB basis (26% on a USD basis), according to Benchmark's Synthetic Graphite Price Assessment.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Quantifies the magnitude of feedstock cost inflation hitting synthetic graphite anode producers — a concrete number for modelling anode margin compression.
insights.quote: prices for pre-calcined petroleum needle coke have risen 23% so far this year on an RMB-basis (26% on a USD-basis)
insights.locator: "As a result of the conflict and the rising cost of feedstock materials..."
